provenance.basis: Fresh owning suites in a clean manifest-only copy; separate clean bootstrap and transfer audit

new_regressions: evidence drift during final source rehash is rejected
atomic file replacement with same size and mtime is rejected
contradictory, partial, duplicate, malformed gate receipts block config/build
real six-gate execution detects a type database collision
scenario lifecycle, build/side mismatch, duplicate keys and SHA drift are rejected
scenario CLI creates no history and launches no child process

github_ci.receipt: Hosted CI for the exact published commit is linked in its GitHub release

limitations: Scenario validation verifies reported data and file identity, not the truth of gameplay observations
File checks detect changes during reads; they do not lock files against changes after validation returns
Python and pack-only checks do not replace Enforce, client/server gameplay or performance measurements
Optional external model and corpora are not included in this portable artifact
